about: The defects planted in the Corner Shop on purpose (PLAN.md 4.7, outlines/typescript.md 4.5). Hidden: checks/ never reaches a workspace. The base (checkpoint legacy-js) has all twelve. defects.test.mjs has one test per defect, named by its id, that fails while the defect is planted, and works: tests that must pass everywhere. fixes/<id> is the smallest change that removes the defect from the base, and the verifier proves it removes that defect and no other.

defects.title: Quantities stay strings
defects.symptom: qty comes from the URL as a string, so adding 2 and then 1 makes "21", and qty=abc is accepted

defects.title: An unknown coupon makes NaN
defects.symptom: applyCoupon returns undefined for an unknown code, and computeTotals does subtotal - discount, so every total is "NaN"
defects.foundIn: challenge legacy-checkout-nan, and TS18048 at legacy-ts

defects.title: No tax rate for the state
defects.symptom: TAX_RATES has no fallback, so a zip in a state the shop has no rate for (99501, Alaska) gives a tax of "NaN"
defects.foundIn: challenge legacy-checkout-nan, and lesson 37 part 3 example 2

defects.title: Free shipping compares strings
defects.symptom: the subtotal arrives formatted as a string and is compared with "50" as text, so a $9.00 cart ships free and a $120.88 cart pays

defects.title: A typo in the sale price
defects.symptom: item.prcie is undefined, so a sale item's line (the Tea Towel, P012) is NaN

defects.title: The order write's error is ignored
defects.symptom: when data/orders.json cannot be written, checkout still answers 201
defects.note: Reporting the write's error means answering after the write, so the fix for L6 also removes L11. L11's own fix leaves L6 in place.

defects.title: applyCoupon changes the caller's cart
defects.symptom: a percent coupon lowers the prices stored in the cart, so asking for the totals again takes the discount off twice

defects.title: The expiry date is compared as text
defects.symptom: "2026-08-31" < a Date is always false, so the EXPIRED coupon still takes 15% off

defects.title: Money in floating point
defects.symptom: the cart's subtotal is a float sum: $9.99 and ten $1.00 bags come to 19.990000000000002

defects.title: Line totals sorted as text
defects.symptom: Array.prototype.sort() compares numbers as strings, so 129.87 comes before 7.50

defects.title: Checkout answers before the order is saved
defects.symptom: placeOrder calls back before the write finishes, so data/orders.json may not have the order yet when the client hears 201 (HU_RACE_DELAY_MS widens the gap so the test sees it every time)
defects.foundIn: lesson 37 part 4 (no-floating-promises after the port to async)

defects.title: The catalog is trusted as it is
defects.symptom: data/products.json is used unchecked: three prices are strings ("12.50"), the Gift Wrap (P019) has no price and can be put in a cart, and the honey's stock is -2
